items.html: And to understand this verse, we shall explain the reality of the matter and say that the Nekudot are nine, namely: Kamatz, Patach, Tzeirei, Segol, Sheva, Holam, Shuruk, Hirik, Kibbutz. Indeed, there are also upper discernments among them, which are the vowel Holam, and a middle one, such as Shuruk; and all the rest are lower ones, whose place is beneath the letters. And afterwards all this will be explained with God’s help.
